(FAQ)

Questions

Do I need an iPhone app, an Android app or a web app?

It depends on who uses it and how often. Many businesses start with a web app that works on every phone, then add store apps once usage proves the need. We recommend a path during the design sprint.

What does the design sprint give me?

A clickable prototype, a feature list for version one and a build estimate. It is yours to keep, whether or not we build it.

Who handles the App Store submission?

We do: listings, screenshots, privacy details and review responses. The developer accounts are in your name.

What happens after launch?

Apps need upkeep as phones and stores change. App Care covers monitoring, security updates, bug fixes and small improvements every month.
